responsibility: This source file implements the function_base expansion logic for the SVE2 and related extension-specific ACLE intrinsics layered on top of the main SVE framework. It adds operation-specific expander classes and function objects for SVE2 arithmetic, widening/narrowing, complex and dot-product instructions, non-temporal gathers/scatters, crypto-extension forms, and other SVE2-only behaviors described in the SVE2 builtin tables.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-sve2 trio, this is the implementation file for SVE2-specific intrinsic semantics: it defines function_base expanders for SVE2 and related extensions, while the .def file enumerates those intrinsics declaratively and the .h file just declares the exported function objects.
